title: tephrosia linearis subsp. discolor
intro: Tephrosia linearis subsp. discolor, commonly known as the "Kukri" or "Kukri bean," is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia linearis subsp. discolor include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Research on the plant has identified a number of bioactive constituents that are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including isomangiferin, mangiferin, and tephrosin.
